resolution: Generation 3 deliberately succeeds generation 2 after executable PR409 counterevidence showed that a caller-minted structurally matching ClockAlignmentWitness could still self-authorize cross-clock comparability. G3 preserves the structural witness relation but separates evidence input from admission authority: distinct clock identities compare only when the exact supplied witness digest is separately present in admitted_alignment_witness_sha256s. Missing admission, an unknown admitted digest, wrong or expired relation, or ambiguous multiple admitted relations remains fail-closed UNALIGNED. When exactly one admitted matching witness is actually used, its digest is bound into ObservationWindow identity and provenance. The PR409 falsifier is permanent regression evidence and both exact PR-head CI and exact merged-main Perception Fabric CI pass. This remains source/test/repository-CI evidence only; upstream witness admission itself and physical clock evidence are not minted or externally attested by this component, so physical clock, device, VPS perception, GRID10/GWT/J-Space, training, effect, completion and whole-system runtime credit remain zero.
